integrity.attribution: Previously published non-overlapping constructions and binary-template lifting are acknowledged and not claimed as new.
integrity.mathematical_basis: Explicit 32-word code; two complete 32-clique vertex covers with independently checked full enumeration and pairwise adjacency.
integrity.reproducibility: Two standard-library Python checkers and all required finite certificates are included.
integrity.source_priority: The earliest cited verified public preprint appeared 2013-03-05; subsequent revisions and journal dates do not determine age.

scientific_limitations: Exact only for quaternary length-five non-overlapping codes of pairwise Hamming distance at least two.
No claim of classification of all optimizing codes or any extrapolation to other parameters.
Single-substitution detection is not single-substitution correction.
A relevant restricted-overlap paper lacks fully accessible text; bibliographic duplication is a residual risk.
title: Sharp quaternary five-symbol synchronization codes detecting one substitution
